name: Signal Amplifier - Ballistics
RelatedDescription: Unceasingly emits EM waves to suppressively interfere with projectiles and disrupt electronic equipment, thus weakening the power of tactical weapons. Also integrates a function that enhances the ST's Ballistics capability.

61172.name: TacW DMG Reduction II · Ballistics
61172.SpecificEffects:
When attacked by a Tactical Weapon, DMG Taken <color=#F74848>-25%</color>.
When engaging in combat with a target at Ideal Range, gain DMG <color=#F74848>+10%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
ST's Body HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
